exceptions.reason: Floating placement keeps position:absolute with its runtime safe-area offset. Android footer-baseline-v2 measures a stable 116px form-footer displacement when NativeWind positioning alone leaves the 48dp control in flow. Classes retain size, shape and semantic colors; footer placement stays in flow.
GestureHandlerRootView requires a native flex style before NativeWind providers mount.
Expo Updates progress and status-bar native APIs require animated/runtime style props; ticket 09 owns its feature migration.

Gorhom Bottom Sheet background, container, handle, and detached sheet APIs require native style objects. The current-detent outer clip follows measured library geometry on the UI thread, preserving the inner keyboard scroll viewport.

T01 (16 Nov 2026): react-native-css 3.0.1 drops an element's className styles when it also receives an inline style, and Reanimated views take no className. Runtime values (shadows, safe-area insets, animated transforms, measured sizes) therefore live on style-only wrappers; static styling stays in className on sibling/child elements.

T02: the floating QA button's position uses runtime safe-area insets on a style-only wrapper (ADR-20261116 style composition: className and style never share an element); the 52pt button and badge keep semantic classes.

PIN keys style from Pressable's pressed state (react-native-css left className :active stuck after disabled toggles, T02), with a window-measured key height; the dots row is a Reanimated shake and each dot's fill/ring follows runtime PIN state (T03).
Unlock gate footers pad by the runtime safe-area inset (resolveDockedFooterInset) under the PIN pad (T03).
The PIN step sizes itself to the visible sheet height (window minus insets) so the pad sits at the bottom of the scrolling form body (T03).
Splash progress dots are a Reanimated width pulse with token colours; the error footer pads by the runtime safe-area inset (T03).

The floating Add payment pill keeps position:absolute with its runtime safe-area offset in style; on iOS the NativeWind absolute/right classes combined with a runtime bottom left the pill in flow as a full-width bar (T31 device QA, as dev-quick-fill found on Android). Classes keep the icon and text tokens.
